testResults.name: zig-metrics-port
testResults.result: 100/100 native tests: the full metric set ported on the scale-18 kernel in a metrics/ folder (common, equity, risk, trades, execution, attribution) with tests colocated next to each module; hand-computed Python vectors pinned including pathological cases, slippage reconciliation exact, scale-18 half-even square root, documented pinned-scale rounding divergences (130/70 -> ...143)

testResults.name: repository-wide-quality-gates
testResults.result: Repository-wide Ruff/format/ty and the pytest suite passed after wave integration

limitations: Float appears only in the final annualization steps (Sharpe/Sortino sqrt multiply, CAGR exponent), mirroring the Python float policy
Per-strategy attribution takes annotated ledger rows and allocates via a caller-provided allocator (metrics are not part of the no-alloc hot kernel path)
